answer: The admission bond is time locked for 17 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are entered in prism, expire in pulse, and quartz lists each expiry. An farming party running 125 aliases as a result needs 180 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1118 identities would post 4750 proofs and burn roughly 15 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
